title: Your Bestseller Is Sending Customers Away
hook: Your bestseller is sending customers to another shop.
script: Your bestseller is sending customers to another shop. It sells out on Tuesday, but nobody notices until Friday. Customers hear, 'Come back tomorrow,' then buy somewhere else. The fix isn't buying more of everything. Identify your five fastest-selling products, check what remains each evening, and note how long suppliers take to deliver. Reorder before you reach zero. Your most popular product should bring customers back, not train them to shop next door. Save this before your next restock.
